title: OmniDecisionBench: Evaluating and Benchmarking the Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28924v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal System One models answer visual tasks with typed decisions and native probabilities, yet no holistic evaluation compares them with general VLMs or maps either class's capability boundaries. We introduce OmniDecisionBench, a holistic benchmark of multimodal System One models. Its main evaluation assigns 45 datasets (192,975 records) to five capability families and twelve primary angles across four typed interfaces, scoring accuracy and candidate-probability calibration. A validation layer adds three single-factor diagnostics varying visual presentation, textual evidence sufficiency, and target dataset. translated_title: OmniDecisionBench：多模态Jev式“系统一”决策模型的评估与基准测试
translated_abstract: 多模态“系统一”模型以类型化决策和原生概率来回答视觉任务，但目前尚无整体性评估将其与通用视觉语言模型进行比较，也未描绘这两类模型的能力边界。我们提出OmniDecisionBench，一个针对多模态“系统一”模型的整体性基准测试。其主评估将45个数据集（192,975条记录）分配到五个能力族和十二个主要评估角度，并覆盖四种类型化接口，同时衡量准确率与候选概率校准度。验证层则增加了三项单因素诊断，分别改变视觉呈现方式、文本证据充分性和目标数据集。在三个“系统一”模型与两个通用VLM的对比中，涌现出三条规律。首先，优势取决于评估角度与指标：“系统一”模型在离散任务上总体领先，在大多数感知、阅读和推理角度上具有更低的ECE15（Jev 1.14：准确率80.14%，ECE15为4.50%），而通用VLM在序数评级任务上领先并超越了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出OmniDecisionBench——首个针对多模态“系统一”决策模型的整体性基准，通过45个数据集、五大能力族、十二个评估角度及单因素诊断层系统比较其与通用VLM的能力边界，发现“系统一”模型在离散任务的准确率和概率校准上占优。
en_tdlr: OmniDecisionBench is the first holistic benchmark for multimodal System One decision models, spanning 45 datasets, five capability families and twelve evaluation angles, revealing that System One models outperform general VLMs on discrete tasks with better accuracy and probability calibration.
